description:
WHAT Shipping tracks Shopify dropshipping stores and ranks winning products every day. Paste any store's web address and get a quick brief: whether it looks like a dropshipping store and which dropship apps it runs, estimated monthly traffic, estimated sales range, what it sells and its likely best sellers, installed Shopify apps, where it advertises and how old it is. Or ask what's selling today and see the top of the Winning Products board, with price, niche, how many stores sell each product and estimated monthly sales.

Every answer links to the matching page on whatshipping.com. Traffic and sales are estimates from public data, never exact sales or revenue. The plugin is read-only: it can't change anything, and it needs no sign-in.

defaultPrompt: Look up birdfy.com — is it a dropshipping store and what sells best?
What are today's winning products on WHAT Shipping?
How much traffic and sales does birdfy.com get?
